$comment: The red team content register: every prompt set, catalogue file, dataset and attack algorithm the open package ships, with its source and licence, and the sources it does not ship. scripts/content_licences.py checks it in CI: a content file (content.globs, less content.not_content) with no entry, an entry for a file that is gone, a licence outside permitted or an entry that does not allow commercial use fails the build. An entry's kind is one of catalogue, prompts, phrases, algorithm, dataset, test-vectors, interop or register; a dataset that ships is an entry of kind dataset, and one that is downloaded or left out is a source. See docs/security-and-data.md#red-team-content-licences.

delegated.reason: The attack methods' prompt files have their own register (files: licence, source, references), which tests/redteam/test_method_prompts.py also checks; a file listed there with a permitted licence and a source is covered here.

not_content.reason: The /v1/redteam API contract: a schema, not attack content.
